newsitem.title: UK: Shield up as managing director adds to stake.
newsitem.headline: Shield up as managing director adds to stake.

text.p: Shares in Shield Diagnostics Plc rose for a second day running on Friday after a directors' share purchase, with managing director Gordon Hall buying 6,700 shares to take his total holding to 24,257 shares.
By 1229 GMT the stock was up 9-1/2p at 125p in volume of 54,400 shares, extending Thursday's 5p rebound from their year's closing low of 110-1/2p on Wednesday.
The purchase came a day after finance director David Evans doubled his stake in the in-vitro diagnostics company.
Earlier this month Shield said it fell to a pre-tax loss of 291,100 stg in the six months ended September 30 from a profit of 43,600 stg a year earlier.
